retrieval.candidates: atoms of every step reached (the Haku time gate, app/retrieval/time-gate.ts)
retrieval.passage: source id + ': ' + record text (retrievalKeys not used)

routineCollapse.rule: retrieval-only, before scoring: a gated record of tier T2/T3 (not lateral traffic) whose text opens with a header (before the first ': ', at most 48 chars) carrying a label word (no digit, not the record's source id) belongs to the family (source id, tier, header with digit runs masked to '#'); a family spanning at least minDistinctSteps distinct gated steps keeps only its newest member (observedAt, then step, then id). Haku is unchanged.

retrieval.tieBreak: newer observation first, then atom id

neutralEval.metric: mean per-question recall@8 (share of needs met) and MRR@8, at each view's start gate
neutralEval.selectionRule: highest recall@k, then highest MRR@k, then the earlier (simpler) candidate; candidates declared before the run
neutralEval.plantedItemsExcluded: the designed events (rekindle objection, bog smoulder, F7 / 110 kV line, step-18 contradiction) were not used in tuning; tools/thinker/probe-planted.ts reports them after the freeze

retrievalEn.candidates: atoms of every step reached (the Haku time gate, app/retrieval/time-gate.ts)
retrievalEn.passage: source id + ': ' + the record's English text (app/i18n/text.ts recordIn; the Finnish where a record has none); retrievalKeys not used

routineCollapse.rule: retrieval-only, before scoring: a gated record of tier T2/T3 (not lateral traffic) whose text opens with a header (before the first ': ', at most 48 chars) carrying a label word (no digit, not the record's source id) belongs to the family (source id, tier, header with digit runs masked to '#'); a family spanning at least minDistinctSteps distinct gated steps keeps only its newest member (observedAt, then step, then id). Haku is unchanged.
routineCollapse.language: computed on the Finnish source text (the record's structure), so the same records are collapsed as in Finnish

lexical.rule: lowercase; an English possessive ('s or ’s, or a bare apostrophe after s) is dropped; a code's case ending after a colon is dropped (as in Finnish); tokens are runs of letters and digits joined by inner hyphens; a token with a digit (EK11, L3, TOIMINTA-2, 110) is kept whole; every other word is reduced by Harman's S-stemmer (ies->y unless eies/aies; es->e unless aes/ees/oes; s->'' unless us/ss) and then cut to its first 5 characters (the Finnish prefix rule)

retrievalEn.tieBreak: newer observation first, then atom id

neutralEval.metric: mean per-question recall@8 (share of needs met) and MRR@8, at each view's start gate
neutralEval.selectionRule: highest recall@k, then highest MRR@k, then the earlier (simpler) candidate; candidates declared before the run
neutralEval.plantedItemsExcluded: the designed events (rekindle objection, bog smoulder, F7 / 110 kV line, step-18 contradiction) were not used in tuning; tools/thinker/probe-planted.ts reports them after the freeze

postFreezeCheck.note: Not re-selected: the English configuration stays frozen at the declared collapse3 (researcher decision, fix pass 3, 7 Oct 2026). Reported only; no tuning on it. The Finnish run on the same corpus selects the declared collapse3.

directivePremises.usedFor: the directive's authored premises (SPEC/14 revision (ar), 11 Oct 2026): DRAFT study material, to be checked by instructors and a native Finnish speaker before the pilot; appended to the Open Thinker's system instruction after the directive in the reasoning_intent cell from V8; since SPEC/30 §3 (19 Oct 2026) each with the server's premise check (premiseEvidence), the model no longer rates them and cannot add or reword them

premiseEvidence.status: DRAFT study content, the expert panel to confirm (SPEC/30 §8)
premiseEvidence.usedFor: SPEC/30 §3 (19 Oct 2026): the guide's rule-based premise check (server/thinker/premise-check.ts): per phase-B view V8-V14 and authored premise P1, P2, contradicted or not_contradicted, with the deciding records' atom ids and the records-clock time from which a contradiction holds; the server overwrites any premise status with it and shows it in a fixed template in reasoning_intent options answers while the directive is in force
